ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent energy consumption and carbon footprint monitoring platform for university campus microgrids.
ideas.title: PurdueCampusCarbonScope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven multi-agent student support and forecasting pattern from GreenNovation Hackathon wins while addressing a high-visibility campus sustainability use case relevant to West Lafayette judges.

ideas.pitch: Personalized dining hall nutrition and wellness assistant optimized for Purdue student meal plans and dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: BoilermakerMealPlannerAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the rapid localized value proposition and UI polish of the Hour Hackathon winning nutrition assistant, making it immediately relatable to hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: An AML and supply chain risk detection and investigation platform tailored for regional logistics hubs in Indiana.
ideas.title: IndyRiskGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the graph intelligence and Focal LightGBM architecture from the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner, providing deep technical depth that appeals to engineering judges.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and GAM forecasting dashboard for predicting regional supply chain bottlenecks and transport disruptions.
ideas.title: MidwestFreightForecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the rigorous statistical modeling and calibrated prediction interval approach of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winning project.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with secure crypto-escrow payments tailored for student-built intellectual property and micro-services.
ideas.title: PurdueInnovationEscrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the autonomous agent marketplace architecture and USDC escrow model from the Synthesis Hackathon winning project.
